newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Bank to issue preferred stock--paper.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Bank to issue preferred stock--paper.

text.p: Fuji Bank Ltd has decided to issue about 210 billion yen worth of preferred stock on the overseas market in December, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Friday.
The bank was not immediately available for comment.
The paper said the move was aimed at boosting the bank's capital, which has fallen due to write-offs of bad loans in the previous business year to March 31, 1996.
The issue was likely to be made in the European market, the paper said.
